# Current status

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import subprocess, json, os, re, shutil
from datetime import datetime

REPO = "ChanceSiyuan/Multi-shadow"

gh = shutil.which("gh") or "/usr/bin/gh"
env = {**os.environ, "NO_COLOR": "1", "GH_FORCE_TTY": ""}

def strip_ansi(s):
    return re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m", "", s)

try:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [gh, "issue", "list", "--repo", REPO, "--state", "all",
         "--limit", "100", "--json", "number,title,url,state,createdAt,labels"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, env=env,
    )
    issues = json.loads(strip_ansi(result.stdout))
    issues.sort(key=lambda i: i["number"])

    print("| No. | Title | Status | Created | Labels |")
    print("|:---:|:------|:------:|:-------:|:-------|")

    for issue in issues:
        n = issue["number"]
        title = issue["title"]
        link = issue["url"]
        state = issue["state"]
        try:
            date_str = datetime.strptime(
                issue["createdAt"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"
            ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        except Exception:
            date_str = issue["createdAt"][:10]
        labels = ", ".join(f"`{l['name']}`" for l in issue["labels"])
        icon = "🟢" if state == "OPEN" else "🟣"
        print(f"| #{n} | [{title}]({link}) | {icon} {state} | {date_str} | {labels} |")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"> **Error fetching issues:** `{e.stderr or e}`")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"> **Error fetching issues:** `{e}`")
```
